verses.raw: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān, [a fire] upon the clay<sup foot_note=255782>1</sup> and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."
